description: ADR-0019: a changed identity withholds the source until re-approval, reported as an identity changed guardrail. Written by hand.

items.detail: the identity expenses runs as is no longer the one the person approved (expense-bot, sha256:825065f93b600dea85b905f0e53d8974bfda1f1257b1a7a0dce98457143a0a9a); its tools are refused until the person approves the new identity, and this call was not run
